main_text.p: ditione, morum suauitate sui in amorem bonos omnes pellexisset, non expectato legitimo tempore in senatorium est ordinem cooptatus.

XIII. Vbi quidem ita suam & ingenij vim atq; præstantiam, & fidem, & prudentiam, & animi magnitudinem, & innocentiam omnibus probauit: vt natu quoq; maiores eum mirarentur, nec inuiti pleriq; in rebus sequerentur: dignum etiam iudicarent, cui grauissimis in negotiis deliberationes & legationes committerent.

XIIII. Neq; in suis illis vel consiliis, vel actionibus quicquam ad honorem & commodum retulit priuatum: illud spectauit, vt cum religione atq; vero Dei veri cultu sarta, quod aiunt, tectaq; libertas maneret.
XV. Neq; etiam in maxima rerum agendarum, cum multitudine tum varietate: autoritate summa: laboribus atq; molestiis prope infinitis, vllum de se vnquam, vel superbiae, vel morositatis signum dedit.
XVI. Sed nimirum ea vitae humanae est conditio vt quod rarum: præstans, eximium, minime fit diuturnum, leuiq; momento euertatur, quod firmissimis nixum radicibus videbatur.

XVII. Cum enim egregiam ille patriae operam nauaret: cum eius in dies fama crefceret: cum de literis literatisq; prouehendis præclara atq; vtilia animo agitaret: ecce ardens eum febris inuasit, quae primo contempta, ita post vires assumpsit, vt illi

page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s throughout. The first paragraph's line "senatorium est ordinem" is printed as "fenatorium eft ordinem"; the "f" for long s is normalised to s. The original line 1 of XIII has "fuam" and "ingenij" as printed. Lines in XVII read "nauaret:cum" with colon as printed. The word "tectaq;" is printed "tectaq;" with a semicolon-q abbreviation. Some words in the italic-like type of the section numerals (XIII–XVII) are set in roman in the printing and are transcribed as shown. The sentence "XVII ... cum de literis literatisq;" is printed as "teris literatisq;" with the first word partly cut by the gutter; reading is conjectural. Words marked [?] were not clearly legible: none marked, but the gutter-side word "teris" should be checked against the scan.
